verdict.rationale: Aleph says it keeps existing financial models and reporting packages in sync with a single source of truth. It describes pull/push sync into Excel and Google Sheets and offers versioned forecasts, so fresh actuals can plausibly flow into an existing model without rebuilding it. Nothing in the evidence shows the forecast itself re-baselining or rolling forward on closed-period actuals. Missing for 10: explicit actuals-replace-forecast or rolling re-baseline after close, documentation of a close-triggered refresh workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
